answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the walnut graph. Re-attestations are stored in tundra and horizon lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 8 dollars and 2 days per identity, which turns a 3745 account sybil into a 5 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
